title: Where two runs differ
description:
Compare two execution traces of your own program to find where they first go different ways.

```
run A (input "abc"): 1240 steps
run B (input "abd"): 1238 steps
first difference at step 912: A 0x1450 jne taken, B 0x1450 jne not taken
```
hints: Walk both with one index until the addresses differ (lesson 3.05).
Lining up again: look for the first later address in A that also appears later in B.
requirements: A trace is a list of `(address, note)` lines.
Find the first step where the addresses differ, and print the step before it (the decision).
Also report how many steps after that the traces line up again, if they do.
stretch: Collapse loops in the traces ("0x1200-0x1230 x 64") so they are shorter to read.
